description: Close delivery with outcome measurement and durable knowledge write-back.

# Retrospective

## Inputs

Release evidence, measured outcomes, incidents, feedback, decisions and follow-ups.

## Process

Read `AGENTS.md`, confirm the active lifecycle state and authority, inspect only relevant canonical artifacts, and make no assumption that is not supported by evidence or an explicit decision.

## Required output

Retrospective, knowledge/index/log updates, superseded ADR links, follow-up owners and dates.

Include artifact paths, traceability links, risks, evidence, owner, and recommended next lifecycle state.

## Stop conditions

Stop if outcomes are unavailable, evidence would expose sensitive data, or decision ownership is unclear.
